name: Old Bay-style crab seasoning (J.O. Spice)
where: J.O. Spice factory outlet in Halethorpe; also check Giant supermarkets in the city
about: This spice blend is a local staple for Baltimore's crab feasts. Locals sprinkle it on crabs, shrimp, fries, and popcorn.
tip: Check the Giant stores in the city first, since they often stock it too.

name: Berger Cookies
about: These are a classic Baltimore cookie with a thick layer of chocolate fudge on top. Locals have eaten them for generations.
tip: Buy them at Royal Farms or Giant, where they are sold widely in the area.
